headline: Expanse Battle Rages as Quiet Sectors Reawaken
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition the wires tell of a shifting desk, with Callahan's Passage falling quiet after its midday stir, logging no change in the last two hours to 18:11 and showing holdings now at nine Warden and one Colonial about the Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post, with day losses listed at 8,611 Colonial and 9,221 Warden. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest traffic on the board, adding five changes in two hours and forty-two on the day about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch to 17:56, holdings now four Warden and five Colonial, with day losses of 6,990 Colonial and 10,093 Warden. Palantine Berm and Mooring County have broken their quiet with two changes apiece in two hours to the cutoff about Leiri Hermanni, the Droll, Wiccwalk and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, while Stlican Shelf presses about Fort Hoarfrost with four changes in two hours and Fisherman's Row logs five about Oceanwatch. Nevish Line has gone quiet, with no change in six hours since the prior evening about Grief Mother.
